## Completeness

Text search finds 4249 `GX*(`/`GD*(` call sites in these 76 files; clang extracted 3614 from function bodies. The difference is code the GameCube-USA (release) preprocessor pass drops, i.e. `#if DEBUG` debug drawing (most of the `m_Do_ext.cpp` and `d_map.cpp` gap) and other versions' arms, plus enum casts that look like calls to a text search (`GXTevColorArg(x)` in `J2DMatBlock.cpp`).
